title: Temperature Keep At Least
prompt: A temperature report should hide small temperature readings. Write a function that returns a new array containing only values greater than or equal to the minimum.

explanation.beginner:
Example: temperatureKeepAtLeast([-3,0,8,15], 5) produces [8,15]. Evaluate the selection rule for every record and preserve the qualifying values in the required order.

Compare “handles empty input”: input [[],5] produces []. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Evaluate the selection rule for every record and preserve the qualifying values in the required order.

Tempting mistake: Selecting a display position after a list changes can identify the wrong item. Use the domain key when matching two collections.
